M6.6 contributes 2 (return and drawdown outcomes on the same state5-vs-state0 restriction -- different statistics, not a redundancy-check pair, same treatment M2's stack_fully_bullish/bearish pair received). M12 contributes 9 (3 sub-questions x 3 lookbacks) -- cross-feature independence explicitly CHECKED this session (2026-09-24), closing a gap M12's own pre-registration had left open ('not checked for correlation before declaring'): per-date median Spearman across all 3 pairs of {relative_volume, dollar_volume, vwma_divergence-at-own-lookback} = 0.00-0.41, well under this study's 0.89 non-redundancy bar at every pair, all 9 kept independent. RESULT: 4 of 79 cells now reject the null at q=0.10 (2 at q=0.05) -- a change in WHICH cells survive, not just how many. New rank 1: ribbon_agreement_extreme_drawdown (M6.6), p=0.00000, smaller than M6.3's own former rank-1 p=0.00005 -- displaces it to rank 2 (M6.3's cell still survives, still clears q=0.05, remains this study's sole Tier-2 finding, confirmed robust to a much larger grid). New rank 3: reclaim_durability_dollar_volume_sma50 (M12), p=0.00348, newly clears. Rank 4 (unchanged cell, new rank): dist_from_52w_low_h126 (M18), p=0.00468, still survives. **3 of the 2026-09-23 pass's 5 survivors no longer clear FDR at N=79** -- ribbon_direction_magnitude (M7, p=0.0077, own threshold shrank from 0.0100 to 0.0063), stack_fully_bearish_h21 (M2, p=0.0086, threshold shrank to 0.0076), above_sma_20 (M1, p=0.0090, threshold shrank to 0.0089 -- the clearest instance in this study of a cell's FDR status flipping purely from denominator growth, since 0.0090 individually cleared the old N=50 threshold of 0.0100). None of these three had reached Tier 2 (each already capped by an independent reason unrelated to FDR), so no tier is downgraded by this. Unlike the 2026-09-23 pass, all 4 current survivors individually clear their own rank's threshold without needing BH's step-up sweep mechanism -- though ranks 3 and 4 clear by only ~8% (p=0.00348 vs threshold 0.00380; p=0.00468 vs threshold 0.00506), tighter margins than anything in the prior pass, flagged as an open Wald-approximation precision caveat specific to those two cells. TIER CALL (checked individually, none newly promoted to Tier 2): ribbon_agreement_extreme_drawdown (M6.6) is capped by its own magnitude-vs-signed-return actionability gap (an avoided-loss/drawdown-shallowing read, not a direct realized-return claim -- the identical limitation ribbon_direction_magnitude/M7 carried, now this study's clearest instance of the pattern since M7's own cell no longer clears FDR at all). reclaim_durability_dollar_volume_sma50 (M12) is NOT promoted despite clearing FDR+cost+C2+reversal-robustness: this panel has no point-in-time market-cap/size control (HANDOVER.md's own infra inventory), and dollar volume correlates strongly with size, so an uncontrolled small-cap/illiquidity premium remains at least as plausible as a genuine mechanism -- an OPEN, UNRESOLVED confound (unlike M6.3's own tail-decomposition, which directly ruled out its analogous concern), same 'flagged by analogy, not resolved by test' standard already applied to M18's dist_from_52w_low_h126. dist_from_52w_low_h126 (M18): unchanged reasoning from the 2026-09-23 pass, still an open survivorship-adjacent caveat, stays Tier 3. Net effect: the FDR-survivor SET changes materially, but the study's actionable conclusion does not -- still exactly one Tier-2 finding (slope_pctile_21_sma_50/M6.3, now confirmed robust to a much larger and more skeptical grid), still zero Tier 1.
